'''Cyril Wynn''' is an [[Murandy|Murandian]] boy born at the end of the [[Aiel War]] in {{Ne|978}}. 

==History==
His father, [[Jac Wynn|Jac]] died from a fall before the fighting began. He and his mother, [[Susa Wynn|Susa]] were made destitute because of this. [[Moiraine Damodred]] takes pity on him and his mother and adds him to the [[White Tower]] bounty, despite the fact that he is too old.{{ref/book|0|5}}
